skill_name: Discuss the ethical implications of using advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems in business.
workflow: The ethical implications of using advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems in business include the potential for discrimination based on race, gender, economic status and other factors. AI can be used to automate decisions which could result in unfair outcomes, so rigorous measures must be put in place to ensure that the data and algorithms are fair, auditable, and transparent.
